title: AssameseLM-E2B: An Open-Weight Assamese Language Model for Efficient Consumer-Grade Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2611.06170v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in high-resource languages, their performance often degrades in low-resource languages due to tokenization inefficiencies, generative instability, and linguistic interference. This paper presents AssameseLM-E2B and its instruction-tuned variant, AssameseLM-E2B-it, a 2-billion-parameter model adapted specifically for low resource Assamese language. Built upon the Gemma-4 architecture, the model incorporates an expanded byte-level BPE vocabulary to reduce tokenization overhead by nearly 500% compared with multilingual 2B--3B baselines. We employ a parameter-efficient Continual Pre-Training (CPT) pipeline with Hybrid LoRA, followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on a balanced, multi-domain dataset to enhance instruction-following and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities.   Evaluation demonstrates a Bits-per-Byte (BPB) score of 0.7488 on FLORES-200, alongside an overall RAG score of 96

translated_title: AssameseLM-E2B：一个面向消费级设备高效部署的开源权重阿萨姆语语言模型
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在高资源语言中表现出色，但由于分词效率低下、生成不稳定性和语言干扰，其在低资源语言中的性能往往会有所下降。本文提出了 AssameseLM-E2B 及其指令微调变体 AssameseLM-E2B-it，这是一个专门为低资源阿萨姆语适配的 20 亿参数模型。该模型基于 Gemma-4 架构构建，并采用扩展的字节级 BPE 词表，与多语言 2B–3B 基线相比，将分词开销降低了近 500%。我们采用结合 Hybrid LoRA 的参数高效持续预训练（CPT）流程，随后在平衡的多领域数据集上进行监督微调（SFT），以增强指令遵循和检索增强生成（RAG）能力。评估结果显示，该模型在 FLORES-200 上取得了 0.7488 的每字节比特数（BPB）得分，同时总体 RAG 得分为 96。
tldr: 本文提出专为低资源阿萨姆语设计的开源 20 亿参数语言模型 AssameseLM-E2B，通过扩展字节级 BPE 词表大幅降低分词开销，并借助参数高效的持续预训练与监督微调，实现了在消费级设备上的高效部署。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AssameseLM-E2B, an open-weight 2-billion-parameter language model tailored for low-resource Assamese, which drastically reduces tokenization overhead through an expanded byte-level BPE vocabulary and enables efficient consumer-grade deployment via parameter-efficient continual pre-training and supervised fine-tuning.
